title: Chicken Teriyaki with Marinade
description: Juicy, tender chicken marinated in a sweet-savory teriyaki sauce — grilled, baked, or stir-fried to perfection. Works with chicken breast or thighs.

method.instruction: Flatten the chicken to about 3/4 inch thick for even cooking. Place in a zipper bag or bowl for marinating.
Combine soy sauce, mirin, sugar, and garlic/ginger until sugar dissolves.
Reserve half for glazing. Marinate chicken with remaining half for 15 min to overnight in the fridge.
Heat grill or pan over medium-high heat and add oil.
Remove chicken from marinade, wipe excess, cook skin-side down first if using skin-on. Flip when golden.
During last 3 min, brush with reserved marinade — it will reduce into a glaze. Cook until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking pan.
Bake chicken for ~20 min, brushing reserved marinade during the last 5–7 min to thicken glaze. Reduce heat if it starts to burn.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and serve over steamed rice.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spoon remaining glaze over the top.
